conversation.description: Conversation ref for this extension, from list_conversations / open_dm / get_conversation_info or an earlier result. Never invented; never valid on another extension.

text.description: Message text (markdown baseline; rendered per channel).

thread.description: Opaque thread anchor from a message or message_ref — the thread/topic container to post into. Distinct from reply_to, which quotes one specific message rather than posting into a container.

reply_to.description: The exact message_ref of the specific message being quoted or replied to — distinct from thread, which is the thread/topic container to post into. Each vendor maps this onto its own reply/quote mechanism; where a vendor has only one such mechanism, thread and reply_to both resolve to it.
